description: Hand-built cases for the IFEval punctuation:no_comma (CommaChecker) audit. Each text is given as Unicode code points so this file is pure ASCII. 'shipped' = IFEval's re.search(r',') reading (ASCII comma only); 'intended' = any character whose Unicode name contains COMMA. A flip means the shipped checker and the intended reading disagree on the no_comma verdict.

cases.note: FULLWIDTH COMMA U+FF0C between two letters. Common in CJK text and in CJK keyboards typing Latin. Shipped sees no ASCII comma -> PASS no_comma; the text visibly contains a comma.
IDEOGRAPHIC COMMA U+3001, the standard enumeration comma in Chinese/Japanese. Shipped PASS no_comma though a comma is present.
ARABIC COMMA U+060C used in Arabic/Persian/Urdu text. Shipped PASS no_comma though a comma is present.
'Yes<FULLWIDTH COMMA>I agree' -- an otherwise-English response that used a fullwidth comma (a frequent artefact of CJK input methods or copy-paste). Shipped PASS no_comma.
Control: a plain ASCII comma U+002C. Both the shipped and intended readings see a comma, so both FAIL no_comma -- no flip.
Control: no comma of any script. Both readings PASS no_comma -- no flip.
